design: Account for every already-reconciled fill by actual order age: below 100 ms, 100 ms up to but excluding 100 ms plus configured cancel latency, and the remainder. Report complete per-day/policy/scenario counts, quantities, missing strict marks and signed 1s/5s/mean values; each partition must equal the existing total. The first two bands precede the earliest possible learned cancel effect for STATIC10/HISTORY10. Actual scoring/cancel effect can be later. Guard/default bands are age descriptions only.
inferential_design: Post-result descriptive accounting, no test, null, confidence interval, model fit, threshold selection, new candidate or frozen-policy change.
limits: Conditional on fills produced by each existing policy. Not a decision-time training population, counterfactual avoidability estimate or fresh-entry value. Earlier base risk/price/data cancellations, withholding, price or size changes remain different actions. Fill marks are not portfolio marked/settlement P&L. Primary/stress failure and the next experiment remain unchanged.
